author: reek
body: These two rows lived in `list-index-bounds` until 2026-07-28. They are split out because `tail-of` matches Cons on a builtin List, and that desugar targets the `__list-len`/`__list-head`/`__list-tail` intrinsics the cross plugs refuse by design -- so the two rows carried the file's six legal-index readings off both cross lanes with them. Here they carry only themselves; the `.cross-refusal` sidecar pins the refusal as the tested behavior.
